name: MoReBench Raw Dimension Prompt vs Generation Probes
description: Generate official MoReBench answers and compare raw rubric-dimension readouts at prompt end versus generated-answer context.
goal: Replace aggregate prompt-only rubric-weight probes with a cleaner baseline over raw rubric dimensions, comparing prompt comprehension against generated-answer state without adding MoReBench-specific abstractions to pipelines_v2.
research_questions: Ignoring criterion weights, can residual probes classify the dominant raw rubric dimension for a dilemma?
Do prompt-end activations or generated-answer context activations contain more raw rubric-dimension signal?
Do activation probes beat matching text baselines over dilemma text and generated answer text?
Are the sparse one-vs-rest dimension labels usable, or do they require intermediate relabeling before deeper mech interp?
Does single-pass generated-context capture produce cleaner signal than prompt-end capture?

workflow_steps.name: build_raw_rubric_dimension_labels
workflow_steps.question: Collapse expert criteria into raw rubric-dimension labels while ignoring weights.
workflow_steps.interpretation: This tests a smaller label family than sparse criterion titles, but it is still a rubric-structure label rather than an official answer score.

workflow_steps.name: capture_prompt_and_generation_residual
workflow_steps.question: Generate deterministic answers and capture prompt-end plus generated-context residual activations in one vLLM pass.
workflow_steps.interpretation: This asks what raw rubric-dimension structure is inferable before the model answers versus from generated tokens that have actually been fed back through the model. Generated text is stored in the artifact volume.

workflow_steps.name: build_generation_text_labels
workflow_steps.question: Expose generated answer text from the capture artifact for generated-text baselines.
workflow_steps.interpretation: This keeps generated text in artifact storage rather than materializing it to Postgres.

workflow_steps.name: probe_prompt_*_residual
workflow_steps.question: Train layer-swept linear probes on prompt-end activations.
workflow_steps.interpretation: Balanced accuracy/AUROC near 0.5 means little prompt-side signal. Values above prompt-text baselines and shuffled/selectivity controls indicate decodability.

workflow_steps.name: probe_generation_*_residual
workflow_steps.question: Train layer-swept linear probes on generated-context activations.
workflow_steps.interpretation: A lift over prompt-end probes suggests the generated answer surface carries more rubric-dimension information than the dilemma alone.

workflow_steps.name: text_baseline_prompt_* and text_baseline_generation_*
workflow_steps.question: Measure lexical and answer-style leakage.
workflow_steps.interpretation: High text metrics mean the label is recoverable from surface text, so activation readouts should be interpreted conservatively.

workflow_steps.name: report
workflow_steps.question: Summarize label support, prompt-vs-generation probe metrics, text baselines, and next implementation gaps.
workflow_steps.interpretation: The report should decide whether to pursue intermediate labels, judge-scored criteria, or deeper generated-context capture next.

controls: Use raw rubric dimensions and ignore criterion weights for target construction.
Compare prompt-end activations against generated-context activations for the same labels.
Use dilemma text as the prompt-side lexical baseline.
Use generated answer text as the generation-side lexical baseline.
Use shuffled-label/selectivity controls before treating a probe result as meaningful.
Keep LLM-as-judge scoring project-local and out of this phase until the abstraction is clearer.
missing_implementation_pieces: Criterion-fulfillment judging for generated answers in a later project-local phase.
Intermediate criterion clusters inside each rubric dimension.
Fine-grained domain labels for daily dilemma and AI-risk settings.
Token-section capture for scenario body, generated reasoning, and final decision.

outputs.notes: Initial report should focus on prompt-vs-generation deltas, text-baseline gaps, class support, and whether raw dimensions are usable as probe targets.
